summary.zh: 写路线图叙事、发布说明与干系人更新
summary.en: Write roadmap narratives, release notes and updates

description.zh: 撰写路线图叙事、发布说明、更新日志和面向不同对象的进展汇报。适合要把计划讲给高管、工程团队或客户听时使用。
description.en: Writes roadmap narratives, release notes, changelogs and stakeholder updates. Use it when explaining plans to executives, engineers or customers, each needing a different level of detail.
